scripts.sdk:generate: buf generate && node scripts/format-generated-sdks.mjs && oxfmt --write sdk/typescript/jsr.json
scripts.sdk:check: bun run sdk:generate && bun run sdk:lint-proto && bun run --filter @soulfiremc/sdk check
scripts.lint: bun run --filter @soulfiremc/sdk build && bun run --filter @soulfiremc/beat-game build && oxlint --type-aware e2e sdk/typescript sdk/beat-game sdk/reference scripts
scripts.format: oxfmt --write e2e sdk/typescript sdk/beat-game sdk/reference scripts package.json tsconfig.json .oxlintrc.json .oxfmtrc.json
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check e2e sdk/typescript sdk/beat-game sdk/reference scripts package.json tsconfig.json .oxlintrc.json .oxfmtrc.json
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run format:check
scripts.fix: oxlint --type-aware --fix e2e sdk/typescript sdk/beat-game sdk/reference scripts && bun run format
